Exam Focus
GROSS: terminologies, relationships, movements, joints, bones and anatomical positions — beginning through osteology.
MICRO: tissues studied, including basic/connective tissues, male and female reproductive systems, embryology covered, plus a few terminologies.
T.O.P: Anatomy Theory of Practical — practicals done so far, including micrographs, reproductive systems and bones; image-based best-answer questions are expected.
